title: Get approval for an advertising sign
what: Get the council's approval before putting up or displaying an advertising sign that can be seen from a road or public place, unless the sign is a permitted type.

sources.title: Advertising Devices Local Law 2021
sources.quote: A person must not, without approval from Council, install, erect or display an advertising device, other than an advertising device that is a permitted advertising device.

sources.title: Advertising Devices Local Law 2021
sources.quote: within or on any building, structure or land if the advertising device is not visible from a road or any public place.
